title: Padel | Calm Joints
description: A short padel kit for between matches on an enclosed court, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Padel is the enclosed-court game, with glass and mesh walls. Lunges, volleys and shots off the wall load knees, shoulders and wrists. Here’s a short kit for between matches, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.
